hero.title: SRM Institute of Science and Technology
hero.summary: SRM College of Agricultural Sciences offers agriculture and horticulture within SRMIST at Baburayanpettai near Acharapakkam. Horticulture began in 2018-19 and agriculture followed in 2019-20. The checked ICAR row explicitly covers the horticulture degree, making programme choice especially important here.

overview.heading: Agriculture and horticulture at Baburayanpettai
paragraphs: SRMIST’s agricultural college provides separate four-year degrees in horticulture and agriculture. Its official 2026 workshop brochure places the campus at Vendhar Nagar, Baburayanpettai, near Acharapakkam. This location needs to be distinguished from the Kattankulathur wording used on an older application form and in the regulator’s recorded address.

The college’s self-study report describes a curriculum combining theory, laboratory work, field visits, experiential learning and rural agricultural or horticultural work experience. Applicants interested in fruit, vegetable and ornamental crops can compare the horticulture route with the broader agriculture degree. Both are advertised offerings; the specific ICAR row checked here names horticulture alone.

programmes.name: B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture
programmes.summary: A separate horticultural science degree, introduced in 2018-19 and explicitly printed in the ICAR row.
programmes.eligibility: 2026 agriculture application page: recognised 10+2 with at least 50% aggregate. Accepted academic groups are Physics-Chemistry with Biology and/or Mathematics, Botany-Zoology, Forestry, Biology-Agriculture or Agriculture; the vocational route is Biology with Agricultural Practices, including theory and practicals.

faqs.question: Is B.Sc. Agriculture the ICAR-accredited course in this checked SRMIST row?
faqs.answer: The row explicitly prints B.Sc. (Hons.) Horticulture, not Agriculture. Broader accreditation requires separate regulator evidence.

faqs.question: Does SRMIST also offer B.Sc. Agriculture?
faqs.answer: Yes. Official college materials identify a four-year agriculture degree introduced in 2019-20.

faqs.question: Where is the agricultural college campus?
faqs.answer: Recent official materials locate it at Baburayanpettai near Acharapakkam in Chengalpattu district.

faqs.question: Is the old application fee a current quotation?
faqs.answer: No. The form specifying INR 1,200 is explicitly labelled 2024. Current fee and selection details must be confirmed.
